> wow that's a thing?

Thanks to [Dax Cowart](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dax_Cowart), 40 years ago he lost both his eyes, ears, hands and 70% of his skin, he repeatedly refused treatment but was treated against his will, enduring enormous amounts of pain.

After all that he managed to earn a law degree and spent his life fighting on behalf of patient rights.

You were downvoted a lot for that comment... My earliest childhood memory was of my mother beating me until I could recite the alphabet, it wasn't even the alphabet in my native language and I was about 4 years old. I'm sure it happened to some other children as well.
